name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: FDA approves Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine after initial pushback
changes.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved a new seasonal flu vaccine from Moderna that uses mRNA technology, the drugmaker announced.

changes.title: The U.S. Relies on Family Caregivers. Millions of Them Are Kids.
changes.summary: The modern health care system requires the work of caregiving to fall to whoever else lives in a household — even if they’re kids.

changes.title: Developer ecosystem expanded
changes.summary: In African tech hubs, developers are picking China’s cheap, freely available artificial intelligence models over more powerful U.S. ones.

changes.title: Takeaways from Tuesday's elections in Michigan and more
changes.summary: Democrats need to rack up as many wins as possible to take back the U.S. Senate, so the party has little room for error.

changes.title: Blanche Defends Pirro but Says Trump Can Fire Her at Any Time
changes.summary: The head of the Justice Department praised the U.S. attorney in Washington after her tense meeting with the president.

changes.title: Suspected Iran Cyberattacks on U.S. Water Supply Follow Years of Warnings and Neglect
changes.summary: Federal and state officials are racing to address an assault on the nation’s water supply that they believe is the work of Iranian hackers.

changes.title: U.S. Cuts Ties With Organ Donor Group After Reports of Abuses
changes.summary: The federal government is ending its contract with a Kentucky nonprofit that it says pressured medical workers to remove organs from patients who were getting better.

changes.title: Why Congress Wants a Closer U.S.-Israel Defense Partnership
changes.summary: A proposal making its way through Congress would integrate the U.S. and Israeli defense and intelligence apparatuses more tightly. Some worry that it is a bad idea.

changes.title: How the Battle of the Little Bighorn reshaped U.S. policy toward Native Americans
changes.summary: It's been 150 years since the Battle of the Little Bighorn, one of the most famous and enduring events in American history. While Native Americans were victorious, the battle reshaped the government's policy toward Indigenous people and still resonates so deeply for so many today. Judy Woodruff reports for her series,.

changes.title: AP Report: Trump's immigration crackdown has detained more than 50 military spouses and parents
changes.summary: President Donald Trump's administration has detained dozens of parents and spouses of active-duty U.S. troops as it rolls back immigration protections for military families to pursue its mass deportation agenda, an Associated Press investigation found.
